title: Suspicious PowerShell command line
description: A suspicious PowerShell command was observed on the device. The command attempted to download and execute a script from an external URL.

title: Ransomware activity detected
description: File encryption behavior consistent with ransomware was detected. Multiple files were renamed with suspicious extensions.

title: Unusual sign-in from anonymous IP address
description: Sign-in detected from an IP address identified as an anonymous proxy IP address. These are often used by people who want to hide their device IP address.

title: Suspicious credential theft tool detected
description: Mimikatz credential dumping tool was detected on the endpoint. Immediate investigation recommended.

title: Phishing email delivered to user inbox
description: An email containing a known phishing URL was delivered to a user's inbox. The email impersonates a financial institution.

title: Lateral movement using WMI detected
description: Windows Management Instrumentation was used to remotely execute commands on another machine in the network.

title: Suspicious DNS query to known C2 domain
description: DNS query to a domain associated with known command-and-control infrastructure was detected from an internal host.

title: Unusual file creation in system directory
description: A new executable file was created in the Windows system directory by a non-system process. Investigation showed it was a legitimate admin tool.

title: Data exfiltration attempt via cloud storage
description: Large volume of sensitive files were uploaded to an unauthorized cloud storage service from a corporate device.

title: Multi-factor authentication bypass attempt
description: Multiple failed MFA attempts detected for a user account, followed by a successful authentication from an unusual location.
